rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı says wine prohibition came in four stages: it was initially permitted, and Muslims drank while the Prophet remained silent.
rows.anchor: Dîn-i İslâm’da hamrın ve müskirâtın men‘i tedrîcen vâki‘olmuştur. Bidâyet-i İslâm’da hamr henüz mubah idi.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ömer ve Muâz ve diğer bazı ashâb-ı kirâm
rows.claim: Umar, Muadh, and other Companions sought a ruling because wine removes reason, occasioning this verse.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Ömer ve Muâz ve diğer bazı ashâb-ı kirâmın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This began the prohibition, but its wording still left a possibility of permissibility; some quit immediately while others continued.
rows.anchor: ilk tahrim bununla başladı. Bunda memnû‘iyet zâhir olmakla beraber cevaz ihtimâli de yok değil idi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After a prayer-related incident, the instruction not to approach prayer drunk was revealed; drinking then sharply declined but continued.
rows.anchor: Bunun üzerine içenler pek azaldı ise de yine vardı.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After Sa'd drunkenly recited satire about an Anṣārī, was struck with a jawbone, and complained, the Prophet prayed for clarity and the final verses intensified wine's prohibition.
rows.anchor: Sa‘d, ensardan birinin hicvini mutazammın bir şiir okumuş, o da bir çene kemiğiyle vurup başını yarmış

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ömer
rows.claim: On hearing the final prohibition, Umar answered that they had completely desisted.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Ömer bunu dinleyince “inteheynâ yâ Rabbi” yani “tamamen vazgeçtik yâ Rabbi!” demiştir.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ali
rows.claim: Ali is reported to say he would neither pray from a minaret built over a well touched by a drop of wine nor graze animals where a wine-tainted sea had dried.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Ali’nin “bir kuyuya bir katre hamr düşse, sonra oraya bir minare yapılsa o minarede ezan okumazdım

rows.speaker: Abdullah b. Ömer
rows.claim: Ibn Umar is reported to say he would cut off a finger that had been dipped in wine.
rows.anchor: Abdullah b. Ömer hazretlerinin de

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Maysir is a verbal noun from yusr or yasar meaning gambling, associated with acquiring or transferring wealth easily and without effort.
rows.anchor: “Yüsr” veya “yesar”dan masdar-ı mîmî olarak kumar oynamak mânasınadır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gambling means staking money on an uncertain, risky outcome whose result is unknown, to give or receive wealth.
rows.anchor: Kumar demek de zar gibi ne olacağı belli olmayan muhâtaralı bir şeye ta‘lîk ile mal vermek veya almak demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pre-Islamic Arabs gambled using games learned from Arabs, Persians, and others, including backgammon and chess.
rows.anchor: Câhiliyede Arablar gerek kendilerinden ve gerek Acemlerden ve sâireden belledikleri “nerd” yani tavla, “şatranc” ve sâire gibi oyunlarla kumar oynarlardı.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A lottery used ten named arrows to divide a slaughtered camel into twenty-eight shares, with seven arrows assigned increasing portions from one to seven.
rows.anchor: Zar makamında ezlâm ü aklâm denilen on okları vardı, bunlara fezz, tev’em, rakīb, hils, nâfis, müsbil, mu‘allâ, menîh, sefîh, vağd derlerdi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Three arrows were blank; participants drew on one another's behalf, losers paid for the camel, and winners donated their portions to the poor.
rows.anchor: Menîh, sefîh, vağd okları boş ve mahrumdur. Bu on kalemin hepsi “rebâbe” denilen bir torbaya atılıp

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the lottery was treated as charity and an honorable practice despite being gambling, maysir came to denote gambling generally.
rows.anchor: meysir evvelemirde diğer kumarlara nazaran ehven-i şer gibi görünen ve hayır zannedilen böyle tevzî‘ü istiksam, yani piyango tarzına ıtlak edilmiş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı cites a hadith classifying children's knucklebone and walnut games as maysir.
rows.anchor: bir hadîs-i şerîfte çocukların aşık ve ceviz oynamaları bile meysirden ma‘- dud olduğu beyan buyurulmuştur.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ali
rows.claim: Ali rejected a wager in which one person promised eggs to another who could eat a specified quantity, ruling that it was gambling.
rows.anchor: bunlar Hazret-i Ali’ye mürâfa‘a oldular, “bu kumardır” diye cevaz vermedi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If even a lottery framed as charity is forbidden, ordinary forms of gambling are forbidden all the more.
rows.anchor: Zaten hayır nâmına piyango haram olunca diğer kumarların haram olacağı evleviyetle anlaşılır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Asking about wine and gambling together points to their customary association.
rows.anchor: Hamr ile meysirin bir sualde derci de müskirât ile kumarın murâfakatlarına işârettir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Both waste wealth and ruin people, and each commonly leads to the other; wine removes reason, enabling innumerable crimes and evils linked to gambling.
rows.anchor: ikisi de malları telef ve insanları perişan eder, ‘ale’l-ekser bunlar birbirine sürükler. Evvelâ hamr aklı selb eyler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their benefits include some pleasure and enjoyment, substantial trade, courage for the fearful, strength of temperament, and windfall gains from gambling.
rows.anchor: Ezcümle biraz neşve ve lezzet duyulur, hayli ticaret yapılır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gains are temporary and illusory, while losses include hangovers, disaster, ruined health, worthless profit, addiction, and individual, social, physical, and moral harm.
rows.anchor: Hâsılı neşe ve lezzetleri ferdî ve muvakkat olduğu hâlde zararları, mefsedetleri hem ferdî ve ictimâ‘îdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because preventing harm takes precedence over obtaining benefit, reason itself requires these practices to be forbidden; imagined small gains risk certain, sweeping loss.
rows.anchor: Def‘-i mazarrat celb-i menfaatten mukaddemdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse entails legal prohibition, but by itself does not state an unambiguous intrinsic ban; some Companions missed the legal force of its rational warning until 5:90–91 gave an explicit, absolute command.
rows.anchor: bu tahrim, li-‘aynihi sarih bir tahrim olmazdı, aklına güvenerek mazarratlarını tahdid ve menfaatlerinden istifade edeceğiz zannedenler bulunabilirdi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı says the later command in 5:90–91 explicitly and absolutely forbade wine.
rows.anchor: sûret-i sarîha ve mutlakada tahrîm-i şer‘î vârid olmuştur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question can ask either what causes or recipients should receive spending, or what amount or property should be spent; the first was answered earlier, the latter now.
rows.anchor: مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ iki mânaya gelir: Birisi neye infak yapılacağını sormak, diğeri de ne infak edileceğini sormaktır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-afw means spending what remains beyond one's necessary needs.
rows.anchor: afvı infak ediniz, yani malınızın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earn wealth through lawful means, then give its surplus beyond necessities to the charitable causes already described.
rows.anchor: piyango, kumar gibi gayr-i meşrû‘vesâit ile değil, esbâb-ı meşrû‘a ile mal kazanınız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dependents include young children, a wife, needy parents, and comparable ascendants; their support counts as one's own, so charity must not leave them or oneself without necessities.
rows.anchor: evlâd-ı sığar, zevce, muhtaç olan ebeveyn ve bunlara mülhak olan usûl; ehl ü ‘iyâldendir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God explains legal signs and proofs so people may reflect, understand their purposes, and act on them.
rows.anchor: tefekkür edip de makāsıdına vâkıf olabilesiniz ve muktezâsıyla amel edesiniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means the revealed signs and Islamic law address both worldly life and the afterlife, rather than being confined to either one.
rows.anchor: Bu suretle din ve şeriat-ı İslâmiye ne yalnız dünyaya ve ne yalnız âhirete münhasır olmayacak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prayer for good in this world and the next is answered by a law that encompasses both realms.
rows.anchor: diye dua edenlerin duasına cevap bulunacaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unbelievers seeking only worldly outcomes can still benefit from Islamic law in this life, though they receive no share in the hereafter.
rows.anchor: bu şeriattan yalnız dünya isteyen kâfirler de büsbütün mahrum kalmayacak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This breadth shows Muhammad's mission as mercy to all worlds and Islam as a universal religion of monotheism.
rows.anchor: risâlet-i Muhammediyenin “rahmeten li’l-âlemîn” olduğu ve dîn-i İslâmın umûma şâmil bir dîn-i tevhid olduğu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those cultivating the hereafter have their harvest increased and, by undertaking to enjoin right and forbid wrong, become the balanced community.
rows.anchor: hars-ı âhiret isteyenlerin harsları müzdâd olacak, bunlar emr bi’l-ma‘rûf ve nehy ‘ani’l-münkeri taahhüd ederek “ümmet-i vasat” olacaklardır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After establishing that divine rulings span worldly and afterlife concerns, the passage turns to the question about orphans.
rows.anchor: Beyan olunacak deliller ve onların ahkâmı böyle dünya ve âhirete şâmil olmakla

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After 4:10 warned that unjustly consuming orphans' wealth is like eating fire, people feared managing or mixing with orphans and raised the difficulty with the Prophet; this verse followed.
rows.anchor: âyeti nâzil olunca nâs yetimlerle ihtilâttan ve onların mallarına bakmayı der‘uhde etmekten sakınır oldular

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reforming orphans' affairs is better than leaving them neglected: supervise their welfare and future, educate them, and grow their property.
rows.anchor: ıslah tarîkiyle hâllerine, mallarına el sürmek onların menfaatlerini, istikballerini gözeterek işlerine bakıp kendilerini ta‘lîm ü terbiye ve mallarını tenmiye etmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Orphans who are brought into one's household through association are one's siblings in religion; religious brotherhood is at least as strong as kinship by blood.
rows.anchor: din kardeşliği ise kan kardeşliğinden aşağı değil daha kuvvetlidir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Quran 49:10 identifies believers as siblings and makes reconciliation and seeking one another's benefit part of that bond.
rows.anchor: medlûlünce uhuvvetin muktezâsı ise ıslah ve nef‘ine çalışmaktır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Neglect may make orphans grow into strangers or enemies, opening serious breaches in social life.
rows.anchor: Aksi hâlde onlar size kardeş değil

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mixing with orphans includes bringing them into one's household through marriage or other family and social ties.
rows.anchor: edecek olursanız ihvân-ı dîninizle olsun

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God distinguishes corrupters from reformers and gives each the fitting reward or punishment; one must not disguise corruption as reform.
rows.anchor: Allah da müfsid ve muslihi bilir ve bunları birbirinden temyiz eder ve ona göre ecirlerini ve cezâlarını verir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had God willed, He could have imposed burdensome duties and made people too occupied or powerless to intervene in orphans' affairs.
rows.anchor: Allah dilese idi sizi zorluklara koşar, ağır tekâlîf ile zahmetlere giriftâr ederdi. Âciz bırakır, yetimlere hiç müdahale ettirmezdi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People should be grateful for the capacity God gives them and deal reformatively, not corruptly, with orphans and minors.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın verdiği kuvvet ve kudrete şükrâne olmak üzere yetimlere ve kāsırlara ifsad ile değil ıslah ile muâmele ediniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty and wise; His commands take effect, and any delay He allows reflects wisdom humans may not grasp.
rows.anchor: Emri behemehâl yerini bulur, imhal ederse o da hikmetindendir. Ve o hikmeti siz bilmezsiniz.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı cites a hadith saying that an orphan's weeping makes the Throne tremble.
rows.anchor: يَهْتَزُّ الْعَرْشُ مِنْ بُكَاءِ الْيَتِيمِ: Yetimin ağlamasından arş titrer.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı cites the Prophetic saying that he and the caretaker of an orphan will be together in Paradise like two fingers.
rows.anchor: أَنَا وَكَافِلُ الْيَتِيمِ كَهَاتَيْنِ فِى الْجَنَّةِ: Ben ve yetimi tekeffül eden cennette şu iki parmak gibiyiz

words: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the angels announced the birth, Mary, certain of her own innocence but astonished by the extraordinary message, asked how she could have a child when no man had touched her.
rows.anchor: Meryem kalb ü vicdânında kendisinden hiçbir şüphesi bulunmadığı ve kelimenin garâbetini de duyduğu cihetle doğrudan doğruya Rabbine teveccüh ve tazarru‘edip

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates and decrees whatever He wills; when He decisively wills a matter, He says Be and it is, confirming this to Mary and removing grounds for wonder among those who know divine power.
rows.anchor: Allah böyle ne dilerse halk u takdir eder

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The secret of the announced divine Word is the creative command Be, and it is.
rows.anchor: Kelimenin sırrı da işte bu كُن فَيَكُونُ idi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here kitab is a verbal noun meaning writing, so Jesus was a wise man able to write.
rows.anchor: Burada “kitab”, kitabet mânasına masdardır. Demek ki Hazret-i Îsâ yazı yazmasını bilir bir hakîm idi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeatedly qualifying Jesus's miracles as occurring by God's permission strongly directs them to the Creator's divinity, against Christian claims of Jesus's divinity.
rows.anchor: Mucizelerde بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ kayıdlarının tekrarı bunların Nasârâ’nın iddiası vechile Îsâ’nın ulûhiyetine değil, hâlıkının ulûhiyetine delâlet edeceklerini kuvvetle beyan içindir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus was a divinely appointed Word and a sign of God through his nature, character, knowledge, wisdom, scripture, writing, actions, and speech; he came as a messenger to Israel.
rows.anchor: Îsâ böyle bir kelime idi.

words: أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus's four miracles challenged supposedly unchangeable custom: shaping a bird from clay, healing the blind and lepers, raising the dead, and reporting what people ate and stored.
rows.anchor: Benî İsrâil’e bir resul olarak gelecek, değişmez zannedilen âdetler hilâfına dört mucize gösterip imana davet edecek

words: وَمُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus affirmed and supported the Torah before him and made lawful for Israel some things that had been forbidden to them.
rows.anchor: önündeki Tevrat’ı tasdik ve teyid

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All Jesus's miracles and his entire mission served one message: fear and obey God, his and their Lord, worship Him alone, and follow the straight path.
rows.anchor: bütün mucizelerinin gayesi tek bir âyete vukuftan ibaret olduğunu söyleyecekti ki bu âyet de şu idi: Allah’tan korkunuz ve bana itaat ediniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whether the annunciation and divine promise were fulfilled needs no separate inquiry: God does not break His promise, the angels are truthful, and Mary received the answer directly.
rows.anchor: meleklerin yalan söylemeyecekleri müsellem olmakla beraber

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The qualification minhu, the angels' announcement, and Be, and it is establish that the Word's realization was certain.
rows.anchor: kelimenin hayâl olmadığını anlatmak için مِنْهُ ile mukayyed olması, melâike ile gelmesi, tahakkukuna delil olduğu gibi كُن فَيَكُونُ’daki فَيَكُونُ da bu babda şüpheye mahal bırakmamış

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fa in the phrase when Jesus perceived also signals the promise's fulfillment in the perceptible world.
rows.anchor: bundan başka bu tahakkuk فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ’da fâ-i fasîha ile âlem-i şuhudda dahi gösterilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus actually came with the described identity, qualities, religion, and call, and his whole life and mission expressed this single message.
rows.anchor: Îsâ bu hüviyet, bu ahvâl ve evsâf ve bu dîn ü davetle bir resul olarak وَجِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus's command to obey him did not ask people to treat or worship him as God; it directed them to worship Allah alone, their Lord and his.
rows.anchor: Îsâ “Bana itaat ediniz” dediği zaman

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is Islam, the true religion; Jesus's call matches Muhammad's call to submit to and obey God and the Messenger.
rows.anchor: Sırât-ı müstakīm, dîn-i hak olan İslâm’dan başka bir şeye davet etmiyor

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus's statement that God is Lord of both is the same testimony to divine unity expressed in Quran 3:18 and 3:19.
rows.anchor: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمُ hakikatinden başka bir davada bulunmuyordu. شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The meaning of Jesus as God's Word is monotheism alone; the clear texts of the Torah and Gospel have this same spirit, against those who chase ambiguous passages for another doctrine.
rows.anchor: kelime-i Îsâ’nın kelime-i tevhidden başka hiçbir mânası yoktu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus is a spirit from God only in the sense and spirit of monotheism.
rows.anchor: Îsâ ancak bu mâna, bu rûh itibariyle bir rûhullah idi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As John came as a herald affirming Jesus, Jesus came affirming Muhammad; Muhammad then came with the Book and Criterion as confirmer of all.
rows.anchor: Yahyâ nasıl Îsâ’yı tasdik eden bir mübeşşir olarak gelmiş ise Îsâ da Muhammed’i öylece tasdik ederek gelen bir mübeşşirdi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If Moses had appeared, he would have affirmed Jesus as Jesus had affirmed him before.
rows.anchor: Îsâ’yı önceden tasdik ettiği gibi tasdik ederdi.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If Jesus and all the prophets appeared while Muhammad taught obedience to God and the Messenger, they would affirm Muhammad and obey his message.
rows.anchor: Muhammed’i tasdik ve teblîğine itaatten başka bir şey yapmazlardı.
